body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> TREXTA introduced 'sketch up', iPhone4 case that anyone can sketch and make by oneself at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
